blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Commuters who pay more or less than the prescribed fare on modern public utility jeepneys (PUJs) can seek action against drivers and operators. The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board in Central Visayas (LTFRB-7) warned that penalties can reach cancelation of their authority to operate.
